variants.candidate: Getting ready is your most comfortable way of not starting. Decide one thing you have read enough about. Send the rough version to someone before the clean one exists. Seek Wood, the Action energy. Wood grows from the ground that fed it: a thing built, a start made before the reading is done. Let it spend what Earth stores.
variants.original: At some point more learning is just fear with a reading list. Trade study for evidence: for every hour that goes in, one small thing comes out where someone can see it. Give each research topic a decision date. Finish one old course before any new one gets your money.

variants.candidate: You start more than your body has strength to finish. Sleep a full night before any new yes. Eat before you plan the next thing. Seek Metal, your own Body energy. Metal is what stays when the wanting stops, the rest under the effort. Let it hold what Wood pours out.
variants.original: A field is judged at harvest, and yours keeps skipping the judging. Twice a year, walk the rows honestly: kill one dead thing out loud, feed the two that actually fruit, and spend one fenced-off risk on purpose. Judge every habit by its yield, and never by its years of service.

variants.candidate: You say the thing to find out what you think, and nothing is left over for you. Read a whole chapter before you answer. Sit with one question overnight. Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth is the bank and the ground: it takes water in and holds it until it clears. Let it hold what Water pours.
variants.original: A river with no banks is a swamp, even a pleasant one. Give your talent one container: one project, one hour, the same time every day. Let yourself be bothered on purpose by one thing that matters. And make the treat follow the work, never replace it.

variants.candidate: You answer to pressure faster than you recover from it. Read the whole message before you answer the next hard call. Keep one evening a week with nobody to report to. Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth takes the blaze in and keeps it as warmth, ground that does not catch. Let it hold what Fire burns.
variants.original: Command works best rationed. Before taking over, ask one question and wait for the whole answer. Rank the week’s fires and let the bottom three burn out alone. Schedule the rest before the crash schedules it for you. Order people can breathe in is the only kind that holds.

variants.candidate: Being right is how you stay in charge of yourself. Ship one finished thing to someone above you by their date. Say your plan to someone who can refuse it. Seek Fire, the Order energy. Fire is heat with a job: it burns toward a deadline and gives force a shape. Let it shape what Metal stores.
variants.original: A body built for effort needs effort to be at peace. Give it a hard weekly outlet, lifting, long walks, manual work. Pair every sitting-heavy day with something physical. When patience runs short, train first and talk after.
